answer_1.quote: Using seed topics and their corresponding metadata, we conduct a semi-automatic process by prompting two state-of-the-art LLMs, GPT 4o (Team, 2024) and Claude Sonnet 3.5, to generate short storylines leveraging the provided prompts... We develop six heuristic rules to guide comprehension option generation and use GPT 4o and Sonnet 3.5 to create 24 options per question
answer_1.outputs: Generated storylines and distractor options for multiple-choice questions

answer_2.quote: The results are presented in Table 3: The accuracy of different LLMs from different types and families on the dataset. We report macro accuracy across the categories

answer_4.quote: To ensure cultural authenticity and accuracy, two human annotators review and revise the model-generated stories without knowing their source models... Human annotators evaluate 4 options per heuristic rule... and select the 2 best options
answer_4.guideline: Annotators either rewrite or select the version that best represent the seed topic without direct reference. This involves editing, adding, or removing information from the stories, and occasionally, complete rewrites
